# Boatrace Data Automation

Boatrace data is spread across proprietary formats, and collecting and formatting it takes time.
To make it easier to use for machine learning, we created CSV files with one race per row.
Because it can be downloaded over HTTPS, it is also easy for Agents to access.
Updates are made once a day (real-time data every 5 minutes).
If you need the latest information, please use another source such as [Boatrace OpenAPI](https://github.com/BoatraceOpenAPI).

## Data Download

All files can be downloaded from the root `https://boatracecsv.github.io/` using the following paths.

- `data/programs/title/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — per-race race name
- `data/programs/race_cards/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — detailed race entry sheet (出走表)
- `data/programs/recent_national/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — nationwide recent form, last 5 sections (節)
- `data/programs/recent_local/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — local venue recent form, last 5 sections
- `data/programs/motor_stats/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — motor period performance stats
- `data/previews/{tkz,stt,sui,original_exhibition}/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — pre-race information (直前情報)
- `data/results/realtime/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — semi-real-time results 5 to 30 minutes after closing
- `data/results/payouts/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — payouts 5 to 30 minutes after closing
- `data/estimate/index/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — strength points (5-factor deviation values + contributions + total)

All files can be joined using `レースコード` (race code, 12 digits, `YYYYMMDDjjrr`) as the common key.

For detailed documentation, see [`docs/`](https://github.com/BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md).

Starfie1d1272/RivalHub.body:
RivalHub is an open-source tournament platform for collegiate esports events. It is currently used mainly for NJU Rivals and NJU Major, covering registration, team formation, eligibility review, scheduling, match management, statistics, and tournament history.

Rivals and Major share accounts, long-term Teams, matches, and data infrastructure, while retaining their own registration methods and format workflows.

The platform's data center is located at `/stats` and by default aggregates all public historical tournaments. The tournament selector can switch to a single edition's scope. Site-wide navigation is fixed as Tournaments, Teams, and Data Center, while in-tournament business entry points remain independent. For statistical definitions and public data boundaries, see [domain model](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/RivalHub/blob/HEAD/docs/domain-model.md). For the interaction contract, see [UI system](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/RivalHub/blob/HEAD/docs/ui-system.md).

## Main Features

- **Players and competitive profiles** — Uniformly maintain identity, educational eligibility, and competitive information, reusable across different tournaments.
- **Teams and participation management** — Teams persist long-term. Each edition separately manages participant rosters, member confirmations, and review status.
- **Registration and eligibility review** — Supports individual or team registration, eligibility verification, corrections, waitlists, and administrator review.
- **Tournament workflows** — Covers drafts, round-robin, Swiss, double-elimination, and Playoffs formats.
- **Match management** — Supports time negotiation, lineups and BP, maps and series results, forfeits, corrections, reinstatement, and disciplinary handling.
- **Statistics** — Provides season leaderboards, match results, and player statistics, and continuously improves cross-tournament historical display.

# 文字起こしちゃん

A macOS app that automatically transcribes and summarizes Japanese meetings. It records your microphone together with the audio of the other participants playing from your Mac, such as Zoom or Google Meet, and in Japanese mode it separates the records by who is speaking. It also has a mode for translating English into Japanese. It uses Apple's speech recognition, translation, and generation models, and keeps recordings and logs only on your Mac.

## Requirements

macOS 26.4 or later on an Apple Silicon Mac. Summaries use Apple Intelligence.

## Installation

1. Download `live-dictation-v1.6.0-macos-arm64.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/minorun365/live-dictation/releases/latest).
2. Unzip the archive and move `文字起こしちゃん.app` into the Applications folder.
3. Launch the app once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and select "Open Anyway".
4. After launch, allow microphone and screen recording access. If asked to restart, reopen the app.

This distributed build has not been notarized by Apple, so step 3 is required only on first launch ([Apple's guide](https://support.apple.com/ja-jp/102445)). The ZIP you get from the "Code" button on GitHub contains the source code, not the app itself.

## Usage

Select a mode at the top and press "Start Recording". Recording starts automatically when a web meeting begins. From the history on the left, you can review the full transcript and summary of past meetings.

| Mode | Expected scenario | What is shown |
|---|---|---|
| Japanese | Japanese web meetings | Transcript with speakers separated and a summary |
| English | English web meetings | English transcript, Japanese translation, and summary |
| In-person | Conversations in the same room | Transcript and summary |

To separate speakers in Japanese mode, use headphones. If you play the other party's voice through speakers, it will be picked up by the microphone and recorded as your own speech.

Recordings and logs are saved to `~/Library/Application Support/LiveTranslator/Sessions/` and are not sent to external servers. Use only with the consent of the people being recorded and the meeting host.

yuzi52/st-yuzi-phone.body:
# 📱 Yuzi Phone (玉子手机)

A standalone phone extension for SillyTavern, providing a phone home screen, real-time QQ chat, a general table viewer, the Theater mini-theater, a world book workbench, and settings management.

## Features

- 📱 Phone container: floating display, drag to move, scaling, and position memory
- 🏠 Home screen and apps: home screen entry, table viewing, and settings pages
- 💬 QQ: standalone conversations, contacts, and message storage, using a user-configured OpenAI-compatible API
- 🔐 API presets: the QQ key is not stored as a plaintext field in regular preset records
- 📚 World book workbench: select the world books and entries that the phone system reads
- 🖼️ QQ media messages: images, voice, stickers, and transfers belong to QQ's own data model
- 🎨 Table and scene styling: general table templates and Theater scenes each render separately
- ⚙️ Data and settings: supports database tables, appearance, and independent local storage

## Development and Release

This extension is a native third-party SillyTavern extension. `manifest.json` actually loads `dist/yuzi-phone.bundle.js` and `dist/yuzi-phone.bundle.css`. The source entry points are `index.js` and `style.css`; build rules are in `BUILD.md`.

The following must be run before release:

```cmd
npm run lint
npm run check:ci
npm run build
```

`check:ci` runs the same checks as `check`, and additionally prevents a silent pass when no check script is found; running `check:ci` once in the release flow is sufficient.

`dist/` must be committed. SillyTavern `auto_update` only pulls repository contents and does not run the build for users. The table template source of truth is in `tables/sources/`. The official table sources are `小剧场2.1` and `纪要`, and `恋爱特化参考` is a reference source. When modifying table sources, first run `tables:build` to update `tables/generated/`, then run `tables:check` to validate, and then run the checks and build above.

The mutual exclusion of the script-version loader and the `window.__YUZI_PHONE_INSTANCE__` singleton guard are checked by `scripts/check-script-loader-contract.cjs`. The version fields are checked by `scripts/check-extension-version-contract.cjs`. The table source boundaries are checked by `scripts/check-table-sources-contract.cjs`. Release/dist delivery passes through build, CI artifact and commit status checks, and manual acceptance confirmation before release.

An Android video aggregation client developed and refined from the open-source project [TVBoxOSC](https://github.com/CatVodTVOfficial/TVBoxOSC) (CatVodTVOfficial), designed for TV boxes, TVs, and landscape-mode phones.

## Project Introduction

Z影视 is a multi-source video aggregation client. It does not provide its own sources. Instead, it combines a set of “collection sources” and “parsing sources” from the configuration into one unified viewing entry: a single search queries all checked sources at once, displays results in the priority order you set, and then passes them to the built-in player for playback.

Compared with the original TVBoxOSC, this project makes many detailed optimizations to the homepage, categories, search, favorites and history, player, and other pages. It focuses on fixing the issues that most affect real-world use: “homepage won't open,” “blank category page,” “search order is messed up,” and “inappropriate playback aspect ratio.”

- Cards are displayed with a full-screen background poster. The background switches in sync with the card, without lag
- After 6 seconds of inactivity, it automatically advances to the next card. Any key press or focus change immediately interrupts this and restarts the timer
